opponent.label: Ameri
opponent.description: The student council president of Babyls Academy in the Underworld, the home of demonkind. Tough, confident, strict, responsible, and imposing, she embodies everything a leader should be. She urges all to follow their ambitions, tackling a great many challenges everyday to make Babyls a better and safer place. However, underneath her sharp and cold exterior hides the heart of a maiden, who loves romance novels and is quite inexperienced in romance and love.
